description: Document-framing policies for raw-text fitting of base language models. Chat-model fitting uses the tokenizer's chat template and does not consult this registry.

EleutherAI/pythia-70m.evidence_note: Pythia training documents are concatenated and separated by an EOD token.

Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B-Base.evidence_note: Qwen documents are separated by <|endoftext|> inside packed pretraining sequences.

Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base.evidence_note: Qwen documents are separated by <|endoftext|> inside packed pretraining sequences.

Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base.evidence_note: Qwen documents are separated by <|endoftext|> inside packed pretraining sequences.

google/gemma-2-2b.evidence_note: The official tokenizer configuration enables add_bos_token and identifies <bos> as the BOS token.

openai-community/gpt2.evidence_note: OpenAI starts unconditional generation—the beginning of a new document—from <|endoftext|>. Conditional prompts are encoded directly without this prefix; this policy applies specifically because each fitting row is treated as a fresh pretraining document.
